name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaces the local edge-wise inequality constraint (bipartiteness) with a global product constraint over all edges. Because the possible edge sums are 2, 3, and 4, and the target product is 3^m, unique prime factorization dictates that every edge sum must be exactly 3. Models that fail to make this number-theoretic deduction will likely attempt to use a general constraint solver or backtracking, failing the time limit.
